name: my_products
description: Products the user bought in recent orders, the same list as the quick shop page on ab.gr. Use it to turn a vague request like 'bananas' into the exact product the user buys: search in Greek and prefer the product bought most often. Products include times_bought, last_bought and every_days once purchase_history has loaded past orders.

query.description: Optional words to filter by, in Greek. Leave it out to list everything.
